items.text: Artificial Analysis launched decision-model benchmarks covering speed, cost, symmetry, and document-based judgment tasks.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis推出决策模型基准，覆盖速度、成本、一致性与文档判断任务。
items.cat_take_en: The benchmark shifts attention from raw intelligence toward operational trade-offs buyers actually face.
items.cat_take_zh: 该基准把评测重点从智力排名转向企业真正关心的成本与执行效率。

items.text: Databricks made Document Intelligence REST APIs generally available for parsing, extraction, and classification in applications and agents.
items.text_zh: Databricks宣布Document Intelligence REST API正式可用，支持应用与智能体解析、抽取和分类文档。
items.cat_take_en: General availability lowers the barrier for document agents, while reliability at messy enterprise scale remains decisive.
items.cat_take_zh: 正式商用会加速文档智能体落地，但复杂企业文档中的稳定性仍是关键门槛。

items.text: GitHub said users can open a Copilot app session directly in VS Code and finish agent-started work inside their IDE.
items.text_zh: GitHub表示，用户可直接在VS Code中打开Copilot应用会话，并在IDE内完成智能体已开始的任务。
items.cat_take_en: The handoff connects autonomous planning with familiar developer control, benefiting teams wary of fully unattended coding.
items.cat_take_zh: 这种交接把自动规划接回熟悉的开发环境，利好希望保留人工控制的团队。

items.text: Recraft Studio added Flux 3 Video Max, Kling 4.0, and Bria Fibo 2 for video drafts, long scenes, and image generation.
items.text_zh: Recraft Studio新增Flux 3 Video Max、Kling 4.0和Bria Fibo 2，覆盖视频草稿、长场景与图像生成。
items.cat_take_en: Aggregating rival models makes Recraft more useful as a creative workspace, but deep provider dependence may limit differentiation.
items.cat_take_zh: 聚合竞品模型增强了工作台价值，但对外部模型依赖也可能削弱自身差异化。

items.text: Elvis and Eminem rights holders sued Suno, alleging its AI music system improperly clones protected voices and styles.
items.text_zh: 猫王与Eminem权利人起诉Suno，指控其音乐系统不当克隆受保护的声音与风格。
items.cat_take_en: The case raises licensing costs for generative music companies and could narrow acceptable training and imitation practices.
items.cat_take_zh: 案件可能抬高生成音乐公司的授权成本，并收紧训练与风格模仿的可接受边界。

items.text: InfoQ examined why AI video generation still creates costly rework despite faster models and increasingly capable creator tools.
items.text_zh: InfoQ分析了为何AI视频模型越来越快、工具越来越强，却仍让创作者承担高昂返工成本。
items.cat_take_en: The bottleneck is controllability, not raw generation speed, leaving professional studios to absorb unpredictable iteration costs.
items.cat_take_zh: 行业瓶颈已从生成速度转向可控性，专业团队仍要承担不可预测的反复修改成本。

items.text: Former Claude Code engineers discussed departures from leading AI laboratories and the pressures shaping frontier-team careers.
items.text_zh: 前Claude Code工程师首次谈及离开顶尖AI实验室的经历，以及塑造前沿团队职业选择的压力。
items.cat_take_en: The interviews expose retention as a strategic constraint: capability can diffuse when specialized agent talent moves between labs.
items.cat_take_zh: 访谈显示人才留存已成战略约束，专门化智能体人才流动会加速能力扩散。

items.text: Simon Willison described implementing SQLite’s parse_number extension in both C and Rust, comparing portability and maintenance trade-offs.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison介绍了用C与Rust实现SQLite parse_number扩展，并比较两者的移植性与维护取舍。
items.cat_take_en: The example favors pragmatic tooling decisions: language choice matters less than deployment friction and long-term maintainability.
items.cat_take_zh: 这个案例说明工程取舍应看部署摩擦与长期维护，而不只是语言本身的性能。

items.text: Latent Space published a discussion of Stanford’s approach to teaching AI-native engineering with Mihail Eric and Monaco.
items.text_zh: Latent Space刊发Mihail Eric与Monaco关于斯坦福如何教授AI原生工程的讨论。
items.cat_take_en: The curriculum signal matters because engineering education is beginning to formalize agent collaboration as a core professional skill.
items.cat_take_zh: 课程变化值得关注，因为工程教育正把智能体协作正式纳入核心职业技能。

items.text: Tripo showcased Bluestone Lane, an interactive 3D story built with its API around cinematic environments and a small robot.
items.text_zh: Tripo展示了用其API制作的互动3D故事Bluestone Lane，围绕电影化场景和小机器人展开。
items.cat_take_en: The demo points to a shift from isolated assets toward API-driven narrative worlds, though production scalability remains unproven.
items.cat_take_zh: 演示显示3D生成正从单个资产走向API驱动的叙事世界，但规模化制作仍待验证。

items.text: Artificial Analysis reported that Celeris-1.1 Decision achieved the lowest task latency at 56 milliseconds in its decision-model comparison.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis称，Celeris-1.1 Decision在其决策模型比较中以56毫秒取得最低任务延迟。
items.cat_take_en: The result favors latency-sensitive workflows, but speed alone cannot justify deployment without comparable accuracy and stability data.
items.cat_take_zh: 该结果利好低延迟工作流，但缺少准确率与稳定性对照时，速度本身不足以证明可部署。

items.text: Artificial Analysis said decision-model prices ranged from $14 to $859 per million tasks, revealing a wide cost spread.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis称，决策模型每百万任务成本从14美元到859美元不等，价格差距极大。
items.cat_take_en: The 61-fold spread makes routing and workload selection economically decisive for companies deploying decision models at scale.
items.cat_take_zh: 高达61倍的成本差距意味着规模化部署时，路由与任务选择将直接决定经济性。
